doc.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020

title: Nine years with J.C. Heard, Dizzy Gillespie, and Aretha Franklin
summary: He stayed nine years with J.C. Heard, met Dizzy through him, and worked with Aretha Franklin's band before that; Monk Rowe mentions playing with Aretha too.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: time Dizzy Gillespie would come through Detroit, he’d be at J.C.’s home, so I had a chance to mingle with Dizzy Gillespie, which was very fortunate you know. Because I stayed with J.C. nine years. That’s the longest I stayed with one band. And before I went with J.C. I went with Aretha Franklin. I worked with the Aretha Franklin band before I got with J.C. Heard.
Well you and I have one thing in common.
I got to play in the sax section with Aretha Franklin one time.
Yes, she had some beautiful charts.
